Text.Text: The missing stock has a paper trail and the operation is closed. That's an account I can finally settle. You've finished my Rain of Steel trials. I have no further work for you here.
This range work requires rank 50 in Throwing. Reach it, then come back about my missing stock.

Throwing arms signed out of my cage never came back. The range crew's docket will tell me who's using them and who authorized it. Defeat six Rain of Steel Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Rain of Steel Czerka Test Docket; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility. I'll give you the Czerka Arms Test Range Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Rain of Steel.

Here's the Czerka Arms Test Range Key. Use '[Enter Czerka Weapons Testing Facility]' in Smuggler's Moon, Corporate District. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Rain of Steel Adepts, then return with the Rain of Steel Czerka Test Docket.

Everyone thinks throwing is spending. It isn't. Rain of Steel is an economy - every blade in the air is inventory in motion, and the hand that masters it never books a loss. You fill the sky and the sky pays you back. That's the doctrine those idiots inside are burning my crates to imitate.

A test crew Czerka stopped paying and forgot to disarm. They run live trials on the range floor with my stock - my stock - and call themselves adepts of the discipline. Adepts don't leave blades in the sand. These do. That's how I know they're counterfeit.

The Czerka Test Docket is the paper trail on every blade they've burned. Without it I can't write off the loss or bill the corpse responsible. With it, the ledger balances and your first lesson gets entered under your name. Paper first. Always.

Defeat six Rain of Steel Adepts in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Rain of Steel Czerka Test Docket; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility.
You've defeated six Rain of Steel Adepts. Let me see the Rain of Steel Czerka Test Docket.
Work order received. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists control the blast-cell regulator. Recover it before they burn through more of my stock. Defeat five Rain of Steel Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Rain of Steel Blast-Cell Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility.
Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Defeat five Rain of Steel Specialists to secure the Rain of Steel Blast-Cell Regulator, then return to me.

It meters the charge on every blast-cell in the range. Without it their trials run hot and every blade I recover comes back warped - scrap value, nothing more. Back on my bench, it re-certifies every lane and every blade you send my way after.

Because a merc company lives and dies on resupply. I watched an outfit on Ord Mantell throw itself dry in one afternoon and get overrun picking up its own knives. Rain of Steel says: what you throw, you recover; what you recover, you throw again. Master that and you never stand empty-handed. That's not poetry. That's stock rotation.

Adepts copy the throw. Specialists copy the system - recovery patterns, cell timing, lane discipline. Mine, all of it, learned through the fence. A thief who studies you is worth five who don't. Treat them that way.

Defeat five Rain of Steel Specialists in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Rain of Steel Blast-Cell Regulator; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility.
You've defeated five Rain of Steel Specialists. Let me see the Rain of Steel Blast-Cell Regulator.
Component received and accounted for. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden is protecting the unauthorized trials. Take his range crest as proof we've broken that protection. Defeat the Rain of Steel Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Rain of Steel Scored Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Rain of Steel Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Rain of Steel Scored Range Crest.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Rain of Steel Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Czerka scores a crest for every weapons line that passes final proof. That one belonged to the recovery-blade line - my line, the trials I quartermastered myself. Every scratch on it is a test I signed for. On his chest it's stolen valor. In my cage it's the range's honest history.

Ex-Czerka range security. When the funding dried up he kept the keys, and when my crew got locked out he kept the ones who stayed, too. He's had a sealed floor and unlimited stock to drill on for years. He throws like a man who's never had to buy his own blades. Make him pay retail.

Defeat the Rain of Steel Warden in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Rain of Steel Scored Range Crest; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Rain of Steel Warden. Let me see the Rain of Steel Scored Range Crest.
The warden's defeat is verified. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four officers still authorize the missing equipment. Recover their clearance chit. Defeat four members of the Rain of Steel Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Rain of Steel Czerka Clearance Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility.

Your key still grants access to Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Defeat four members of the Rain of Steel Inner Circle to secure the Rain of Steel Czerka Clearance Chit, then return to me.

Everything. Gate codes, stock draws, trial permits, my old signature authority. Whoever holds that chit IS the range, as far as Czerka's ledgers care. That's why it comes to me and nowhere else. I'm the last man whose name was on it honestly.

The warden's paymasters. Two came up through procurement - they know stock movement better than fighting, but don't relax. The other two were trial leads with a thousand hours of range time apiece on the discipline you're still learning. Together, the four of them will be a worse fight than the warden. Keep your two beside you. I extended their issue for a reason.

After the chit? The master. And no - I don't talk about the master while the circle's still countersigning. One line at a time. A ledger that skips ahead is a ledger hiding a loss. Ask me again with the chit in your hand.

Defeat four members of the Rain of Steel Inner Circle in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Weapons Testing Facility. Their defeat secures the Rain of Steel Czerka Clearance Chit; bring it back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility.
You've defeated four members of the Rain of Steel Inner Circle. Let me see the Rain of Steel Czerka Clearance Chit.
Authorization recovered. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the last hand keeping the range operation going. Defeat him in the Czerka Blast-Safe Cell. Defeat the Rain of Steel Master in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Blast-Safe Cell. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Blast-Safe Cell, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Rain of Steel Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

He quartermastered this range before me. Taught me that a blade left behind is a debt. When Czerka pulled out, he stayed with the stock, and I signed out with the people. I've wondered every day since which of us balanced that ledger right. Go make the question academic.

Then the doctrine transfers to the last hand standing - that's how it has always passed. You'll throw the way he throws: sky full, hand never empty, every loss recovered before it lands. And my cage stays open to you for life. Gear's loyalty for loyalty. That's the only sentiment I stock.

You don't. You out-supply him. Three of you means every recovery gets contested - each blade he lands near, one of yours is already claiming the ground. Starve the return line. The moment his off hand reaches for a rack instead of his belt, he's feeling the only shortage he's ever known. Spend it.

Defeat the Rain of Steel Master in Smuggler's Moon, Czerka Blast-Safe Cell. Report back to me here in Smuggler's Moon, Fabrication Facility; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Rain of Steel Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The missing stock has a paper trail and the operation is closed. That's an account I can finally settle. You've earned the right to train Rain of Steel. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the shortfall.
I'll defeat six Rain of Steel Adepts.
What is Rain of Steel to you?
Who's arming up on your stock?
Why does one docket matter so much?
Your count can wait.
Here's the Rain of Steel Czerka Test Docket.
About the regulator job.
I'll defeat five Rain of Steel Specialists.
What does the regulator actually do?
Why do you keep calling this an economy?
What makes a specialist worse than an adept?
Put me down as pending.
Here's the Rain of Steel Blast-Cell Regulator.
Back to the warden.
I'll defeat the Rain of Steel Warden.
Would you recommend bringing help?
What's the story on the crest?
Who is this warden?
I need to muster a crew first.
Here's the Rain of Steel Scored Range Crest.
The circle. Go on.
I'll defeat four members of the Rain of Steel Inner Circle.
What does the clearance chit authorize?
Who are the four?
And after the chit? What's left?
Their account stays open a day longer.
Here's the Rain of Steel Czerka Clearance Chit.
Back to the master.
I'll face the Rain of Steel Master and report back.
You knew him?
And if I beat him - what then?
How do I fight a hand that's never empty?
Not until my count is right.
The Rain of Steel Master is defeated. Here's my report.
